paite: Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat bel lungmuangtak in Jerusalem a a-inn ah apai nawnta hi.
heading: Zawlnei Khat In Jehoshaphat Atai

paite: Huchi in zawlnei Hanani tapa Jehu in ana dawn a, kumpipa Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Migilou na panpih in ToUPA ho mite na it ding ahi maw? Hiai ziak in TOUPA thangpaihna, na tung ah ahong omta hi.
Himahleh hiai gam a kipan Asherah na paimang a, TOUPA na zon ziak in hoihna lam banghiam khat na nei lai hi," achi hi.
Jehoshaphat bel Jerusalem ah a-om a; huan Beer-sheba a kipan a Ephraim tanggam pha in amite lak ah ahoh nawn a, TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian lam ah ama'n apikik nawn vek hi.
heading: Jehoshaphat Puahthakna Bawlte

paite: Huchi in kho chih ah Judah gam kulh nei khopi tengteng ah vaihawmte akoih a, vaihawmte kiang ah,
"Na thilhih uh hoihtak a ngaihtuah in hih un, mihing a ding a vaihawm na hi kei ua, TOUPA a ding ahi zaw ngal a; vaihawmna ah na kiang uah atel zel ahi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA lau unla, pilvangtak in hih un; TOUPA i Pathian ah gitlouhna, khentuam neihna leh golh neknate a-om kei," achi hi.
Huchi in Jehoshaphat in Jerusalem a ahong kik nawn un TOUPA vaihawm ding leh thubuaite lemmi ding in Levite, siampute, Israel inkuan makaite akoih behlap hi.
"TOUPA laudan siam kawm in muanhuaitak in, lungsim diktak pu in na hih ding uh ahi.

Koi lai khua a mi in leng thubuai ahong gen ua, tualthah thu, dan leh thupiak thu, dan thuseh leh vaihawm thute a hong kilan uleh, TOUPA tung a thil ahihkhelhlouhna ding un amau pilvangtak in na hilh ding ua, nou leh na unaute uh tung ah thangpaihna ahong tung zenhouh kha ding; huchibang in hih le uchin, mohsak in na om kei ding uhi.

"Huan ngai dih ua, TOUPA lam thu tengteng ah siampu lianpen Amariah bel na heutu uh ahi a; kumpipa lam thu tengteng ah Judah inkote tung a vaihawmmi Ishmael tapa Zebadiah ahi: Levite leng na heutute uh ahi sam ding uh. Hangtak in hih unla, mihoihte kiang ah TOUPA om hen," achi hi.
